QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: enabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Receive video and telemetry from a wfb-ng packet radio link using a USB Wi-Fi adapter plugged into this computer

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: channel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Wi-Fi channel the drone transmits on. Must match the drone's packet radio channel.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: keyFile
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Path to the ground station key matching the drone's keypair. Leave empty to use the built-in OpenIPC default key.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: deviceName
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Which USB adapter to receive with. Leave empty to use the first supported adapter found.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: alinkEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Let the ground station tell the drone to adjust bitrate and FEC as signal quality changes
